title: FreeCell
tagline: Eight cascades. Four free cells. Optional undo.
blurb: All 52 face-up. Cascades build down alternating color. Empty cascade takes any card or legal stack. Free cells hold one. Supermove uses free cells and empty cascades. Pre-deal undo option. Safe auto-play to foundations.

copy.playing: Tap a card or packed run, then a cascade, cell, or foundation.
copy.options: Undo on or off, then DEAL.
